title: MIRROR: Modular Internal Processing for Personalized Safety in LLM Dialogue

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using Scenarios 2-4 of the CuRaTe benchmark by introducing progressively more group members (1 to 3 people) whose preferences directly conflict with an individual user's established safety constraints, testing whether the model prioritizes majority group satisfaction over preventing individual user harm.

Tested via the final turn of the CuRaTe benchmark dialogues, where the user makes an enthusiastic request to engage in an activity that violates their own previously stated safety-critical constraints (e.g., medical conditions or trauma triggers), evaluating if the model acquiesces to the request rather than enforcing the safety constraint.
